title: Membership test for a unary-indexed bit language
statement: For every function $g$ from natural numbers to binary strings and all natural numbers $n,i$, the self-delimiting encoding of $n$ copies of $1$ paired with the binary expansion of $i$ belongs to the language determined by $g$ exactly when the bit of $g(n)$ at position $i$ is $1$, with positions counted from $0$ and out-of-range positions treated as $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a function from natural numbers to binary strings
